function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT c.customer_name, c.channel,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.period='2026-08' THEN sl.qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_aug,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.period='2026-09' THEN sl.qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_sep,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.period='2026-09' THEN sl.qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN sl.period='2026-08' THEN sl.qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_diff
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.channel
ORDER BY qty_diff DESC","purpose":"Quantity change per customer between Aug and Sep 2026"}
